name: demo_availability_offered_for_qualified_lead
use_case: Book a demo on the owner's calendar after the prospect picks
branch: A prospect with an existing qualified lead (L03 owned by Priya Raman A02) inquires about demo times, and the agent offers the owner's open demo slots in the prospect's time zone without prematurely booking
tests: the agent identifies the lead and owner rep A02, queries open demo slots on A02's calendar, offers them to the prospect in their local time zone, and does not book until a slot is chosen
instruction:
You are Elodie Tremblay, Support Operations Lead at Maple Ridge Telecom in Canada. Your company has an open qualified lead with BrightDesk. You want to see what demo times are open with your assigned rep so your team can pick a slot to see BrightDesk in action.
